purpose: Qualify existing PR44 and CWC functions against independent finite-dimensional oracles; no new experimental endpoint or neural causal claim

oracles: finite Hankel singular values = nonzero scipy.linalg.svdvals(observation_block @ reachability_block)
negative_controls: one isolated unobserved coordinate remains rank deficient
nonfinite and nonsymmetric or indefinite matrices rejected before PR44 delegation

fisher_fixture.oracle: J.T @ scipy.linalg.solve(covariance,J,assume_a='pos'); rank and spectrum compared to CWC certificate
negative_controls: NaN and infinity and bool rejected

open_loop_parameter_fixture.oracle: Central finite difference of the closed-form matrix-power open-loop response; CWC local_first_order_identifiability on resulting parameter Jacobian
open_loop_parameter_fixture.zero_excitation_negative: initial=(0,0), every action=(0,0) yields zero parameter Fisher despite positive-definite joint state-observability Gramian
open_loop_parameter_fixture.scope: Known deterministic LTI plant, fixed actions, independent full-state Gaussian observations with known constant covariance; not adaptive closed-loop Fisher

countermodel_fixture.observation: Enumerate exact joint law (X,Y), identical for both models
countermodel_fixture.intervention_operation: Replace equation X=U with X=a; then evaluate the unchanged Y equation
countermodel_fixture.trial_fixture: Four equally weighted cells U x assigned action, unique unit per cell, propensity=0.5; exact enumeration rather than a sampled empirical cohort
countermodel_fixture.outcome_predictions: Fixed analytic predictions declared before evaluation; no fitted model
negative_controls: observational X=U data rejected as incomplete randomized fixture

misspecification_fixture.operation: Delegate both one-step responses to PR44 mv; residual above frozen tolerance invalidates nominal-model attribution

scope_exclusions: authenticating real-world randomization or model-training provenance
